None presents the child’s distinctive Good Friday structure, Christian observance, or a sufficiently specific sequence or formulation to establish that it supplied a concrete and material drafting template.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"the observance will fortify the hearts of men and women of good will ... in their quest for a just peace and for a better life for human beings everywhere on earth","parent_excerpt":"Those same qualities today can strengthen the men and women of the United States and of all freedom-loving countries in the search for prosperity with fair opportunity, for peace with justice ... we too shall build a new and better world for human living.","explanation":"C06 has the strongest conceptual and sequential parallel, but the language is general commemorative rhetoric rather than a distinctive reusable formulation."},{"child_excerpt":"those spiritual values which guide them in their quest for a just peace","parent_excerpt":"You have been a towering leader in the quest for peace ... courage is many times fortified by dedication to human freedom","explanation":"C13 shares the motifs of a quest for peace and moral dedication that fortifies people, but not the child’s structure or subject-specific drafting."},{"child_excerpt":"fortify the hearts of men and women of good will ... for a better life","parent_excerpt":"fortifying their devotion to liberty ... hope for a better future","explanation":"C08 contains a notable pairing of fortification and hope for a better future, though it appears in a different rhetorical and factual framework."}]}
